services.title: Full Service Design
services.description: For substantial residential projects requiring interior architecture, spatial planning, furnishing and design management from early planning through completion.

services.title: Furnishing & Procurement
services.description: For homes or defined areas requiring furniture, lighting, rugs, artwork, custom pieces, procurement, installation and final placement.

services.title: Pre-Purchase Design Review
services.description: For clients seeking design insight before committing to a property, including its spatial potential, limitations and likely implications.

services.title: Layout Assessment
services.description: For existing plans that need closer review before key decisions are fixed, with attention to function, flow, proportion and long-term liveability.

services.title: Design Positioning Strategy
services.description: For properties being prepared for sale, development or market positioning, where design direction needs to support the intended buyer.

services.title: Design Consultation
services.description: For clients who require a considered starting point before the appropriate scope, service pathway and next steps are confirmed.
